headings.title: Functions, powers, and duties of the director
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates fifteen functions, powers, and duties of the director including licensing, discipline, complaint investigation, rulemaking, subpoenas, examinations, fee collection, staffing, hearings, and NMLSR agreements.

headings.title: Chapter 536 rulemaking compliance and nonseverability
headings.reviewNote: Requires chapter 536 and section 536.028 compliance for rules under section 443.869 and includes a nonseverability clause invalidating post-August 28, 2001 rulemaking if legislative review powers are held unconstitutional.

entries.reviewSummary: Replaced both completely hallucinated draft headings (which erroneously described advertising rules) with source-bound headings for director functions/powers/duties and chapter 536 rulemaking compliance/nonseverability.

headings.title: Duty to file additional reports requested by director
headings.reviewNote: Requires every licensee to file any additional reports requested by the director beyond those otherwise mandated by sections 443.701 to 443.893.

headings.title: Class A misdemeanor for nonfiling, false entries, or delay
headings.reviewNote: Makes a broker or its officer, director, employee, or agent guilty of a class A misdemeanor for failing to file required reports, making false entries with intent to deceive, or purposely delaying filings.

entries.reviewSummary: Replaced both completely hallucinated draft headings (which erroneously described subpoenas) with source-bound headings for additional director-requested reports and class A misdemeanor penalties.

headings.title: Director grounds to suspend or revoke license on notice
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director upon written notice to suspend or revoke a license for statutory/rule violations, conditions that would have warranted original denial, or disqualifying conduct by an entity's principals or ultimate equitable owners.

headings.title: Notice of right to hearing before disciplinary action
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits license suspension, revocation, or other disciplinary proceeding without notice of the licensee's right to a hearing under sections 443.701 to 443.893.

headings.title: Emergency license suspension up to thirty days pending investigation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes emergency license suspension for up to 30 days pending investigation upon good cause shown.

headings.title: Pre-surrender civil and criminal liability unaffected
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that section 443.835 does not affect a licensee's civil or criminal liability for acts committed prior to license surrender.

headings.title: Preexisting lawful contracts unaffected by license action
headings.reviewNote: Provides that revocation, suspension, or surrender of a license does not impair preexisting lawful contracts.

headings.title: Duration of license and director reinstatement authority
headings.reviewNote: Provides that licenses remain in force until expiration, surrender, revocation, or suspension, and authorizes director reinstatement or reissuance if no disqualifying condition exists.

headings.title: Public notice, service of order, and board review
headings.reviewNote: Requires public notice and service of revocation or suspension orders upon the licensee, subject to residential mortgage board review.

headings.title: Authorized disciplinary actions for statutory violations
headings.reviewNote: Lists five disciplinary actions the director may order upon finding a subsection 9 violation: revocation, conditional suspension, probation, reprimand, or license denial.

headings.title: Seventeen enumerated grounds for disciplinary action
headings.reviewNote: Enumerates seventeen grounds for subsection 8 disciplinary actions including fraud/dishonesty convictions, misrepresentation, escrow/trust violations, insolvency, failure to release unfunded mortgages, unlicensed activity, and subpoena refusal.

headings.title: Licensee vicarious liability for officer and employee violations
headings.reviewNote: Subjects a licensee to disciplinary action for subsection 9 violations committed by officers, directors, members, shareholders, partners, joint venturers, ultimate equitable owners, or employees.

headings.title: Knowledge or pattern required for employee-based suspension or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Limits suspension or revocation based on employee actions to cases involving a pattern of repeated violations or licensee knowledge of the violation.

headings.title: Procedures for license suspension, revocation, and voluntary surrender
headings.reviewNote: Establishes 10-day certified-mail hearing notice procedures for suspension or revocation and written-notice procedures for voluntary license surrender (without fee refund or liability release).

entries.reviewSummary: Replaced all 12 completely hallucinated draft headings (which erroneously described CPA annual audits) with source-bound headings for license suspension/revocation grounds, hearings, emergency suspension, disciplinary actions, vicarious liability, and surrender procedures.

headings.title: Director administrative rulemaking authority for mortgage industry
headings.reviewNote: Covers director authority to promulgate rules defining fraudulent practices, interpreting terms, and enforcing mortgage lending statutes.

headings.title: Specific administrative rulings and demands authorized
headings.reviewNote: Covers director authority to issue specific demands, rulings, and findings necessary for proper conduct of mortgage industry.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: permissive general director rulemaking powers and specific rulings, demands, and findings.

headings.title: Notice of charges, license revocation, removal orders, and fines
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes director notice of charges for fines (up to $25,000 per occurrence), restitution, license suspension/revocation, or removal/prohibition orders upon four preliminary findings; original-rolls footnotes note omitted "of" and "depositary".

headings.title: Administrative hearing procedures under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Covers requirement that administrative hearings on director charges be conducted in accordance with chapter 536 contested case rules.

headings.title: Default orders, consent decrees, and judicial enforceability
headings.reviewNote: Covers issuance of final orders upon default, consent, or evidentiary findings, effective thirty days after service.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text (noting original-rolls footnotes for omitted "of" and "depositary" in subsection 1): notice of charges, removal/prohibition orders, $25,000 fines, chapter 536 hearings, and final/default/consent orders.

headings.title: Short title
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory designation as the Missouri Reverse Mortgage Act.

headings.title: Definitions for reverse mortgages
headings.reviewNote: Covers statutory definitions for authorized lender, brokered, originated, principal, and reverse mortgage loan.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections against archived text: Missouri Reverse Mortgage Act short title and five statutory definitions.

headings.title: Scope of mortgage modification provisions
headings.reviewNote: Covers applicability of sections 443.920 to 443.925 to real property mortgage modifications.

headings.title: Unaffected statutes governing priority, recording, and future advances
headings.reviewNote: Covers clarification that mortgage modification statutes do not alter content rules, limitations periods, recording acts, tax liens, or frauds acts.

headings.title: Exclusions for collateral releases, obligor changes, and assignments
headings.reviewNote: Covers exclusion of modifications that release or add encumbered property, alter loan obligors, or assign mortgages or obligations.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text (L. 2026 H.B. 2636 merged with S.B. 834): mortgage modification scope, unaffected statutes, and three excluded modification types.

headings.title: Continuing security, priority retention, and non-novation effect
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that qualifying modifications continue securing obligations, retain recording priority without new filings, and avoid novation.

headings.title: Qualifying mortgage modifications retaining priority
headings.reviewNote: Covers ten qualifying modification categories including maturity extensions, rate reductions, interest capitalization, and covenant changes.

headings.title: Non-qualifying mortgage modifications governed by other law
headings.reviewNote: Covers rule that legal consequences of mortgage modifications not enumerated in subsection 2 are governed by other law.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text (L. 2026 H.B. 2636 merged with S.B. 834): continuing security/priority/non-novation effect, ten qualifying mortgage modifications, and other law for non-qualifying modifications.

headings.title: Unlawful practices in loan applications and real estate closings
headings.reviewNote: Covers prohibitions against fraudulent schemes, material misstatements, unlawful closing fee receipt, and appraisal extortion or bribery.

headings.title: Unlawful practices deemed mortgage fraud
headings.reviewNote: Deems acts prohibited under subsection 1 to constitute mortgage fraud.

headings.title: No private right of action created
headings.reviewNote: Covers express statutory limitation providing that section 443.930 shall not be construed to create a private right of action.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections against archived text; removed unstated "criminal" qualifier from subsection 2 reviewNote to match statutory text ("deemed to constitute mortgage fraud").
